# Eiffel Tower Official Ticket Office

> > Official online ticket booking platform for the Eiffel Tower (Tour Eiffel), operated by SETE, offering e-tickets with guaranteed pricing from €2.60 to €35.30.

This is the authorized ticketing website for visiting the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The platform provides multilingual access for purchasing tickets to France's most iconic monument, with integrated analytics via Piano Analytics and Google Analytics.

## Key Topics

- Eiffel Tower (Tour Eiffel)
- Online ticket booking
- E-tickets and pricing
- SETE (operating company)
- Visitor information
- Multilingual support (French, English, Spanish)
- Cookie management and privacy
- Data tracking and audience measurement
- Official ticket office (billetterie)
- Monument access levels
- RSA security
- Social media integration
- Browser requirements (Javascript)
- User privacy protection

## Ticket Booking

- [English Ticket Office](https://ticket.toureiffel.paris/en): Official Eiffel Tower ticket booking page with pricing from €3.60-€35.30
- [French Ticket Office (Billetterie)](https://ticket.toureiffel.paris/fr): French Tour Eiffel ticket booking with guaranteed pricing (€3.60-€35.30)
- [French Homepage](https://ticket.toureiffel.paris/): French homepage for Tour Eiffel official ticket booking (€3.60-€35.30)
- [Spanish Ticket Office (Taquilla)](https://ticket.toureiffel.paris/es): Spanish version of Torre Eiffel official ticket office (€2.60-€25.90)

## Optional

- [Cookie Management](https://ticket.toureiffel.paris/en/useful/cookie-management): Cookie management and privacy settings for tracking and analytics
